scope: Remaining complete original bodies in exact family cohort order; prerequisite review only.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references, licenses, concrete input datasets and runtime dependencies remain separate uncompleted prerequisites unless recorded elsewhere.

sources.workflow: Apply the declared brand palette, heading and body font rules and cycling accent colors to an actual visual artifact, using the specified fallback fonts when needed.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete editable artifact and styling goal, the complete source license, and an actual compatible artifact-writing environment. The document names python-pptx color objects and system fonts or explicit fallbacks; neither package availability nor rendered output was verified here.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded actual presentation-styling task could be offline after license, input and runtime review. A JSON palette listing alone is not an applied presentation change. The text does not independently establish readability or cross-system fidelity.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect the actual artifact package for exact RGB and font properties and preserved contents; render it independently when claiming visible typography or layout. Separate structural property checks from subjective brand quality and font substitution behavior.

sources.workflow: Apply a conversation-dependent decision rule for whether to append two or three concrete reflective questions after a substantive answer, at most once per conversation, with the explicit educational, formatting, coding and user-opt-out exceptions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual answer, user request and relevant conversation history, including whether a nudge has already appeared and whether checking was already requested. No external service is inherently required; interpreting borderline substantive content needs an adjudication rubric.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded transcript-conditioned output task is offline-capable, but no concrete transcript or independent judgment scheme has been frozen. A formatting-only test would not verify correct application of all semantic exceptions or improved user discernment.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Use independently labeled conversation fixtures and blinded human adjudication for applicability and specificity; deterministic checks can separately enforce question count, length, exact lead-in, position and once-per-conversation state. No model self-rating can establish interpretive correctness.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
